intro.title: Report Library
lines: All of your organization's reports live here, grouped by type.
We'll walk through Daily Cashout — the end-of-day cash
reconciliation process for front desk staff and managers.
intro.narration: Welcome to the Daily Cash Out walkthrough. Every finance report lives in the Report Library — we'll focus on Daily Cashout, the report front desk staff and managers use to reconcile cash at the end of a shift or the end of the day.

steps.title: Cash Out · Overview
lines: A rollup of cash, check, card, and account-credit payments,
by team member and desk location, for your date range.
Individual shift reports live under the Reports tab.
steps.narration: Clicking in opens the Overview — a rollup of cash, check, card, and account-credit payments by team member and desk location for the date range you choose. The individual shift reports live under the Reports tab.

steps.title: Cash Out · Reports
lines: Every Cash Summary Report — filterable by Drafts, Submitted, or Archived.
Front desk staff save a report at the end of their shift,
and it stays a Draft until a manager reviews and submits it.
steps.narration: Reports lists every Cash Summary Report, filterable by Drafts, Submitted, or Archived. Front desk staff save a report at the end of their shift, and it stays a Draft until a manager reviews and submits it.

steps.title: Draft Report · Not Yet Submitted
lines: Staff enter the drawer total and deposit slip number, then save.
Actual is compared to Expected automatically.
A note is required to explain any over or short amount.
steps.narration: Here's a saved draft. Staff enter the drawer total and deposit slip number, then save — Rec compares that to the expected amount automatically. If the two don't match, staff must leave a note explaining the over or short before it can be submitted.

steps.title: Submitted Report · Reviewed
lines: Once everything balances, a manager submits the report to lock it in.
From here they can download, print, or archive it once reviewed.
steps.narration: Once everything balances, a manager submits the report to lock it in — this one already has. From here, a manager can download it, print it, or archive it once they've reviewed it.
